subject: [hw] DONE DEC03 rev 5: LAT trace order handled (latch=>fetch-ready, 0xa3 no rewind); N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2811/2811
body:
DONE DEC03 rev 5. This supersedes rev 3/4; the only changes since rev 4 are from reading the DEC02 LAT trace order:

1. LAT_VLD 0x11108 = 0x101 latches the reader; the trace never writes LAT_VLD 0x1108c = 0x100000. A latched reader now counts as fetch-ready, so a later LAT_VLD +0xe8 poll returns. [I], documented in REGISTERS.md (0x3a row, section 5).
2. LAT_AVC_VLD 0x1228c = 0 (0xa3) is written after the latch. The model stores 0xa3 without moving the reader; a rewind there would undo the latch. The new test programs the trace order and checks the peek and bit position are unchanged. [I], same choice as opus-dec2's reference model.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/run_tests.sh
  -> N2VLD checks 927 pass 927 (x2: ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2)
  -> N2VLDV checks 478 pass 478 (x2: phone libvcodecdrv.so under the A32 interpreter)
  -> DEC03 arm64 iOS compile: n2vld.c ok
  -> N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2811/2811
Optional oracle: bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/oracle_ref.sh -> N2TEST DEC03-oracle PASS 12/12.

Everything else from rev 3 stands. Not done / unresolved: T02 hook not landed (exact text posted; the POLL loop and WRITE_MASK merge are the integration points), LAT vs core is [I], no decode completion/IRQ/pixels, VLD pointer units [I], EPB edge cases, no phone, no publish. Files: tests/hw/vdec/{n2vld.h,n2vld.c,t_vld.c,t_vendor.c,run_tests.sh,oracle_ref.sh,REGISTERS.md} and dsh-state/workers/DEC03/STATUS.md. 124 KB, no file over 300 KB, SPDX MIT. Staying available for review findings.
